question: Which country hosted the 58th Annual Meeting of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) in 2025, where India discussed the Strategic Action Plan 2025-2029?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Italy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Asian Development Bank (ADB)** is a regional development bank established to foster economic growth and cooperation in the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• The **58th Annual Meeting** of ADB in 2025 was hosted by **Italy**, marking a significant step as the meeting was held outside Asia.
 
• **Italy**, being a member of ADB, has demonstrated its commitment to global partnerships and sustainable development by hosting this prestigious event.
 
• During the meeting, **India** presented its **Strategic Action Plan 2025-2029**, focusing on long-term goals such as economic development, infrastructure growth, and poverty alleviation.
 
• The meeting serves as a forum for member countries to discuss important regional issues, financial strategies, and collaborative projects.
 
• Italy's hosting of this event reflects its active participation in international economic policies despite being geographically outside the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• This meeting also highlighted Italy's efforts to strengthen ties with Asian nations and contribute to global economic stability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **China**__

 __
 
• **China** is one of the founding members of ADB and a major contributor to its funding.
 
• China has hosted multiple international events and conferences but did not host the 58th Annual Meeting of ADB in 2025.
 
• The country is known for its significant role in regional development and its Belt and Road Initiative.
 
 
 
• **Japan**__
 __
 
• **Japan** is a key member of ADB and one of its largest contributors.
 
• The headquarters of ADB is located in **Manila, Philippines**, but Japan has been instrumental in shaping ADB’s policies and projects since its inception.
 
• Although Japan regularly participates in ADB meetings, it was not the host for the 2025 event.
 
 
 
• **India**__
 
 
• **India** is a founding member of ADB and actively engages in its developmental initiatives.
 
• India’s **Strategic Action Plan 2025-2029** was discussed during the meeting, focusing on key areas like infrastructure and sustainable growth.
 
• Despite its strong involvement, India was not the host for the 58th Annual Meeting in 2025.
